A full conversion mod of cultist simulator created to teach [[Lifeism]].

== Plot ==

# Learn basic lore
# Enter Mansus
# Reach Stag Door
# Solve Stag Door Riddle
# Split is hard for hand and non-hand now

=== Plot for non-hand ===

# Go on the run 
# gain 4 catgirl marks through various means
# Start revolution (which gains a mark)
# Work for world revolution

=== Plot for hand ===

# Sacrifice people to get up to top
# Become cop (or already be one)
# Kill everyone
# Game ends

=== Plot for insistent cop ===

# Burn file twice
# Burn memo from men in black
# Go on the run
# Gain obscurity or get catgirl temptation
# If you get catgirl temptation then move to catgirl plot
